final: WITH grouped AS (SELECT a.player_id, p.death_country, SUM(a.g_1b - a.g_cf) AS group_sum FROM appearances AS a JOIN player AS p ON a.player_id = p.player_id GROUP BY a.player_id, p.death_country), overall AS (SELECT AVG(group_sum) AS avg_sum FROM grouped) SELECT SUM(g.group_sum) AS total_group_sum, AVG(g.group_sum - o.avg_sum) AS average_excess FROM grouped AS g JOIN overall AS o ON o.avg_sum IS NOT NULL WHERE g.group_sum > o.avg_sum
